The core modeling functions are osc(), hill(), hillside(), flat(), same(), exp2(), log2(), recip(). When you need to remind yourself what the shape is, you can plot any of the functions here. You can also evaluate the function for a given input here. 
```{webr}
#| caption: "Plot any core modeling function"
slice_plot( osc(x) ~ x, domain(x = -3:3))  # plot
osc(2) # evaluate for a given input
```
